in_sanskrit.name: Keshu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Hair, Goddess Kali
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Keshu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Keshu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kesh', which means 'hair'. This name is also associated with Goddess Kali, who is often depicted with long, flowing hair. In Hindu mythology, Keshu represents strength, power, and protection.
